title: Ash dieback removal in Lewes
body:
A mature ash affected by ash dieback had to be removed after becoming increasingly unstable. Treevolution dismantled the tree in controlled sections, working carefully around the garden and surrounding property. The remaining stem was then shaped into a garden throne — the customer's ‘Queen B’ seat.

Customer feedback: ‘So our big Ash tree had to come down, sadly Ash die back so would end up completely unstable. The end result a throne for, as Alastair said his ‘Queen B’. Thank you Henry Brown and gang from Treevolution for all your hard work — looks fabulous.’
alt: Ash dieback tree removal in Lewes
